运行所选真实模型（Ctrl+Enter），不会改用回放数据: Run the selected real model (Ctrl+Enter); playback data is never substituted.
选择 WAV 文件，也可将文件拖入窗口: Choose a WAV file or drag it into the window.
音频波形，点击选择片段起点: Audio waveform; click to set the clip start
也可点击波形选择起点: You can also click the waveform to set the start.
暂无结果。点击音素行试听附近；时间是发射线索，不是已确认的音素边界。: No results yet. Select a phone to hear the surrounding audio. Times are emission cues, not confirmed phone boundaries.
文本导出使用人工 IPA 修改: Use edited IPA for text exports
GAME 从音频识别音高、起点和终点，与音素结果合成为 VSQX。支持整首；无需: GAME detects pitches, onsets and offsets from audio, then combines them with phones to create VSQX. Whole songs are supported; manual confirmation is optional.
GAME 模型目录（本地；CPU 四线程）: Local GAME model folder (4 CPU threads)
配置 local-notes.json 或选择已有模型目录: Configure local-notes.json or choose an existing model folder
保留实际秒数；导出音高由音高模式决定: Preserves actual timing in seconds; export pitch follows the selected pitch mode.
生成 VSQX（GAME 音高与起止点）: Create VSQX with GAME pitches and timing
使用已保存 GAME 音符（不重复推理）: Use saved GAME notes (no repeated inference)
导入已有 VSQX 并生成音素草稿: Import existing VSQX and create a phone draft
音符预览（原始识别／导入音高，移调仅用于导出）: Note preview (original recognized / imported pitch; transposition applies only to export)
尚无音符数据；TXT 仅为辅助音素导出。: No notes yet. TXT is an optional phone export.
起点（秒）／时值（秒）／音高 MIDI／音素来源: Start (s) / duration (s) / MIDI pitch / phone source
例如 http://127.0.0.1:18080；留空使用系统代理: e.g. http://127.0.0.1:18080; blank uses the system proxy
启动时自动下载缺失模型: Automatically download missing models at startup
PhoneticXeus：Apache-2.0；GAME 权重：CC BY-NC: PhoneticXeus: Apache-2.0. GAME weights: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 (noncommercial use only). Models are enabled after file verification. Recognition runs offline.
仅检查公开正式版，不会自动下载或替换程序: Checks public stable releases only; does not download or replace the app automatically.
保存脱敏错误码、模型文件状态与资源信息；不会上传，可在模型未就绪时使用: Saves sanitized error codes, model file status and resource information locally. Nothing is uploaded; models do not need to be ready.
只回放已有结果，不执行真实模型推理: Replays saved results only; does not run model inference.
GPU 状态尚未检查: GPU status has not been checked
真实识别、结果回放和人工修改分别标记。: Model recognition, result playback and manual edits are labeled separately.
